newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada 91-day T-bill yields avg 3.062 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada 91-day T-bill yields avg 3.062 pct.

text.p: The Bank of Canada said the average yield at this week's auction of C$2.2 billion of 91-day Government of Canada treasury bills due August 14 was 3.062 percent, up from 3.001 percent last week.

The average yield on C$1.0 billion of 175-day T-bills due November 6, 1997 was 3.431 percent, up from 3.364 percent last week, and on C$1.1 billion of 364-day T-bills due May 14, 1998 was 3.966 percent, up from 3.961 percent.
The Bank bought C$500 million three-month, C$100 million six-month and C$100 million one-year bills. It holds C$975 million of C$5.3 billion bills due May 22. (Details follow)
For details of the latest week's T-bill auction, see BOCWATDC ENTER. For details of next week's T-bill tender, see BOCWATCK ENTER.
